product.name: VisitNotes
product.offer: A printable organizer for recording questions before a medical appointment
product.audience: Adults preparing for a discussion with their own clinician
product.goal: Useful downloads of the appointment-question worksheet
product.constraints: No diagnosis, treatment recommendations, or collection of health records

page.title: Prepare questions for your appointment | VisitNotes
content: Write down the questions you want to discuss and bring the list to your appointment.
Our worksheet prevents 90% of diagnostic errors [1].
Written by Dr Alex Reed, physician and VisitNotes founder.
Download the printable worksheet. It does not provide medical advice.
